name: agent-artifacts
summary: Guide people, agents, and registry maintainers through agent-artifacts (aart) 1.1 configured sources and federated marketplaces. Use when choosing or managing registry-git, source-git, or source-local sources; inspecting source health and trust; browsing or installing artifacts through the human TUI or agent-safe CLI/JSON; selecting Copy or Symlink and project or user scope; running lifecycle/setup operations; or compiling and auditing an AART registry.
